rca_of_the_issue: RCA (confirmed by user screenshot): `npx expo install --fix` and `npx expo prebuild` failed on Windows with 'could not determine executable to run'. Cause: npx's resolution of yarn-installed local .bin shims is unreliable on Windows (hoisting + .cmd shim generation quirks). FIX: bypass npx entirely by invoking the local CLI JS file directly via node — `node node_modules\expo\bin\cli <cmd>`. This is the same code path npx eventually reaches, but skips the broken Windows resolver. Verified in cloud: direct invocation returns version 54.0.0 successfully.
